### Step 1 — Scene
An Asian-style meal tray: two fresh spring rolls, two sushi pieces, chicken-and-sweetcorn-style soup, shredded salad with chicken, fruit salad, a milky hot drink, and dipping sauces. I include the dishes grouped on the tray.

### Step 2 — Vessels
Estimated diameters and areas:
- Roll/sushi plate: **24 cm → 452 cm²**
- Soup bowl: **21 cm → 346 cm²**
- Salad plate: **20 cm → 314 cm²**
- Fruit bowl: **17 cm → 227 cm²**
- Mug: **8 cm → 50 cm²**
- Small sauce cups: approximately **4 cm each → 13 cm² each**

### Step 3 — Visible items
Rice-paper spring rolls; sushi maki; creamy-looking soup containing corn and shredded chicken/egg; shredded cabbage, carrot and herbs; chicken strips on the salad; mixed fruit; a milky hot drink; dark and reddish dipping sauces. No separately measurable oil is visible.

### Steps 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
Percentages refer to each item’s own vessel. Heights are average food depths; densities provide the only adjustment for gaps.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Two spring rolls | 20% of roll plate | 90 × 2.0 = 180 ml | 0.85 | 153 g | 155 | 237 kcal |
| Two sushi pieces | 9% of roll plate | 41 × 1.7 = 70 ml | 0.90 | 63 g | 150 | 95 kcal |
| Chicken–sweetcorn soup | 75% of bowl | 260 × 1.4 = 364 ml | 1.00 | 364 g | 55 | 200 kcal |
| Shredded salad vegetables | 65% of salad plate | 204 × 1.5 = 306 ml | 0.50 | 153 g | 30 | 46 kcal |
| Chicken on salad | 10% of salad plate | 31 × 1.0 = 31 ml | 0.95 | 30 g | 165 | 50 kcal |
| Mixed fruit | 65% of fruit bowl | 148 × 1.7 = 252 ml | 0.60 | 151 g | 55 | 83 kcal |
| Milky hot drink | 100% of mug interior | 50 × 4.2 = 210 ml | 1.00 | 210 g | 20 | 42 kcal |
| Dipping sauces, combined | 70% of each cup | 18 × 1.1 ≈ 20 ml | 1.00 | 20 g | 50 | 10 kcal |

Coverage check: rolls and sushi together cover about **29%** of their plate; salad components cover **75%** of theirs. The other vessels’ coverage is shown individually.

### Step 8 — Sanity check
Estimated total: **1,144 g and approximately 860 kcal**, including the drink and sauces. Food alone is about **934 g**. This is plausible for the several dishes visible; the greatest uncertainties are the soup recipe, roll filling, and drink composition.
